newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Bonos closed virtually unchanged on Friday after erasing part of earlier gains just before the end, depressed by profit-taking in the Italian market.
"We're depressed by selling in Btps which were expecting December CPI data later today," a dealer said.
But trade here was sluggish, with no important news on either the domestic or the international front.
"We traded sideways all day and I wouldn't expect anything more in the next week, as many dealers will be away on holiday," a dealer in Madrid said.
The 10-year spread over German Bunds was trading at 118 basis points, while the differential over their Italian counterparts was at 58 bps.
